units.source_text: 旅居渐次安定，已届梅雨时节。

en.t: Life in exile gradually settled down, and the rainy season had already arrived.

units.source_text: 遥念京华旧事，可恋之人甚多：

en.t: Thinking from afar of old days in the capital, there were so many people he longed for:
Lady Murasaki must surely be full of sorrow;
how was the Crown Prince faring now;

units.source_text: 小公子夕雾想必依旧无心无思，嬉戏度日吧？

en.t: and young Yugiri was probably still innocent and carefree, passing his days at play, was he not?

units.source_text: 此外这边那边，心中挂念的人多得很，便写了许多信，遣使入京传送。

en.t: Besides these, there were many others here and there who weighed on his heart, so he wrote many letters and sent a messenger to carry them to the capital.

units.source_text: 其中寄二条院紫姬的及师姑藤壶皇后的信，写时常因泪眼昏花而再三搁笔。

en.t: Among them, when writing to Lady Murasaki at Nijo and to his aunt, Empress Fujitsubo, his tear-blurred eyes often forced him to set down his brush again and again.
